text:
tori: Kickoff: DevStarter Relay. Goal: tiny OSS refapp + how-to + reproducible bench + 25m webinar. Targets: 750 signups, 160 live attendees.

samir: Dates?

tori: Publish Jul 12, webinar Jul 26. Drafts due Jun 28.

lin: Bench plan: cpu / small-gpu / 4-bit quant. I'll output p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens. Need canonical prompts (support convo, doc summarization trimmed to 512, short embeddings).

abe: Repo: two services (api + demo), docker + one-click deploy badge. Keep README quickstart < 10 lines with expected metrics. I'll add a GH Action smoke bench.

tori: Lead magnet: gated "DevStarter Playbook" PDF. Form fields: name, email, company size, role, checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" -> AE routing. Use UTMs: campaign=devstarter-relay, source=(webinar|blog|tweet).

lin: Bench runs Jun 20-24. Will attach CSV + small plot for blog. Also include a methods appendix with commands + image tags for reproducibility.

samir: Messaging: primary angle = "forkable, production-minded starter". Secondary = "benchmarks you can run yourself". Keep headlines tight.

tori: Draft headline ideas: 
- "DevStarter Relay: fork, deploy, benchmark"
- "A tiny starter for production LLM inference"

abe: Webinar format: 6-min recorded demo, 9-min bench walkthrough, 6-min ops tips (KV cache, batching, quant), 4-min Q. Promo clips: 20s + 40s.

marketing-bot: Checklist created: https://ok.redwood/launch/devstarter-relay (repo, tutorial, bench csv, slides, gated pdf, form).

tori: Owners: tori (launch owner), abe (repo + deploy), lin (bench + methods), samir (content + slides).

samir: Social plan: 5-tweet thread, 2 short demo clips, LinkedIn post, OSS newsletter outreach. I'll draft copy by Jun 18.

abe: Repo notes: examples < 12 lines, include `README.md` quickstart and a CONTRIBUTING.md for bench PRs. GH Action will run smoke bench on PRs.

lin: Adding quantized numbers and a small "how to cost-optimize" checklist (quantize, cache, batch) for the playbook.

tori: Need approvals on messaging/screenshots by Jul 3. If approvals miss, delay publish one week.

samir: RSVP link for promos: https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_campaign=devstarter-relay

tori: Next sync Jun 25 10am PT. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
